heading: Birthday songs
headline: Happy Birthday.
description: Celebrate with Vocal U. Request a personalized birthday video for $5 or an in-person birthday song for $50 from the University of Minnesota a cappella group.
intro: Know someone with a birthday coming up? We'll sing for them.

packages.title: Birthday video
packages.description: We'll record Happy Birthday with their name in it. You get to send it.
packages.details: Tell us when you need it. We'll arrange delivery with you by email.

packages.title: In-person song
packages.description: Happy Birthday or Birthday Sex, sung live. Your call. Tell us the time and place.
packages.details: We'll confirm the date and location before you pay.
